summary: DNS of the Re = 100 cylinder in forced transverse oscillation (A = 1.08, f = 0.1643) from rest. The wake locks to the forcing: its period equals the forcing period and the field at the same phase of the forcing stops changing.
description: The mesh moves with the cylinder (userParam05 = 1.08 diameters, userParam06 = 0.1643), without sponge and without filter, so that the flow can settle on a periodic orbit of the forcing period. The run writes one field per forcing period, all at phase 0. plot.py measures the period of v at the probe (5, 0) over the last 10 periods and the change between the last two fields in the near field (-2 < x < 10, |y| < 4). The expected period is the forcing period 1 / 0.1643 = 6.086427, not a value read back from a run. The near-field change falls by a factor 0.88 per period after period 12 (3e-1 at period 2, 4.7e-5 at period 30). The change over all nodes is larger (1.1e-3 at period 30) because the far wake, left by the start-up, leaves the domain slowly; it is not used. The amplitude of v at the probe is a regression value of this repository.

probe_period.note: Mean spacing of the upward zero crossings of v at the probe over the last 10 periods equals the forcing period (observed 6.086385, 6.9e-6 relative).

last_change.note: Relative change of the velocity between the last two fields (both at phase 0) in the near field (observed 4.7e-5).

probe_amplitude.note: Half the range of v at the probe over the last 5 periods (regression value).

n_fields.note: One field per forcing period: the run reached 30 periods.
